candidate.title: TCR Chain Pairing
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina TCR Chain Pairing schematic depicts cell-based emulsion RT-PCR with within-compartment α–β overlap fusion and post-emulsion nested PCR with suppression of nonfused templates, associated by the card with Turchaninova et al. (2013). The two RNA/cDNA branches are separate local instances until fusion. Recovery and paired-end Illumina sequencing are text-supported boundary interfaces. The suppression inset explains the companion process during post-emulsion amplification, rather than a serial transformation of the fused product. The scope ends at a paired CDR3-region DNA library and its sequence readout, not full-length receptor cloning. TCR-LA-MC PCR is only a similar-method link; the listed kit, review, Sprouse cloning workflow and Munson application do not create additional schematic targets.
